# Dilemma v3.4.1

Quiz feedback now uses Dilemma's warm voice and contextual kaomoji across all six languages, including votes, Sparks, hints and bets. Compact controls and statistics stay readable.

- Inset the quiz frame and clip its decorations so Discord's rounded image display preserves all four corners.
- Place a gold spark icon and balance inside the score profile card, including a zero balance. Remove the separate balance line above the card. Keep the balance in alternative text and the text fallback.
- Cover rounded image clipping, zero and large balances, six-language feedback and existing profile badges with regression checks.

No database migration or Discord command registration is required when upgrading from v3.4.0. Earlier upgrades still require the migrations and command registration documented in the README.
